applies_why: The judge text assesses a collision between the challenger's seed/loins chain and the defender's chain, so K-C governs weighing those chains against each other.
quote: the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter; the defender's chain is footed but rests on the woman-route inference.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires
room: ‘does not name Joseph as the begetter’: either a forbidden demand for explicit naming/word-for-word statement, or a permissible chain-footing/support gap
why: The judge faults the challenger's chain for not explicitly naming Joseph rather than resolving the collision solely by the footing of the two chains, so it applies the retired stating-verse/word-for-word test.
